changelog:
1. Cross-Network Audio: IMA-ADPCM 4:1 audio compression enables crystal-clear voice across 4G/5G mobile carriers and Wi-Fi
2. Caller Name Priority: Saved contact names (e.g. Sameed) always display on incoming and in-call screens instead of hardware chip IDs
3. Vivo 24/7 Background Persistence: Upgraded wake locks and 75s presence heartbeats keep Vivo always online even when screen is off
4. Multi-Device: Full compatibility for Vivo Y51L (Android 5.0), OnePlus, Samsung Galaxy M35 & S24 Ultra
